text:
maria: opened a short PR to unify guidance for 429s, timeouts, and server-side context trimming. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1602 :wave; aim is one concise reference for SDK teams and support.
kevin: nice. please call out Dedicated burst buckets vs Hosted rate-limits in one line (they behave differently for sub-minute spikes).
sam: add tiny Retry-After parse examples (js + py) and mention jitter + fractional seconds.
nina: runtime sometimes retries to a compatible model variant which can return 200 with a warning or fewer tokens  include a short mapping of visible outcomes so customers know what success can mean.
maria: added mapping: rate limit -> 429; runtime abort -> 504; context trimmed -> 200 with "context_trimmed": true in payload. added JS/Py Retry-After snippets and a one-sentence flow for "when to stop retrying" (spike vs sustained).
docs-bot: checklist  PR 1602: link-check, snippet-lint, SDK cross-ref. assigned to @kevin for review. :white_check_mark:
sam: small nit: add runbook link for "intermittent 429s without console quota spike"  it's helped root-cause before.
maria: added runbook link and a short combined mitigation example (backoff + reduce-batch). merging after kevin thumbs. pinging @support to surface if customers ask.
support: thanks  we'll watch tickets and report any gaps.
maria: merging in ~30m if no objections. :rocket:
